summary: Simplify Ord setup and preserve the current automatic resource phase when rebudgeting
details: Setup displays memory, cache and disk quantities in readable binary units while preserving exact configuration values when Enter is pressed.
The local minting option uses recommended Ord resources without advanced numeric prompts, preserving existing custom limits and explaining that free-disk reserve is not total index capacity.

Setup, set-minting and set-resource-policy retain the existing automatic resource phase when recalculating budgets. Enabling Ord reserves its memory without resetting a steady node to the Bitcoin-only bootstrap phase; startup still checks readiness and advances through the existing resource strategy.
New configurations and transitions from manual to automatic resource management still begin in the Bitcoin phase. Existing node data, credentials and manual service allocations are retained.
